title: Score Regularized Policy Optimization through Diffusion Behavior

methods.one_paragraph_description: Extract a simple deterministic (Dirac) policy pi_theta(s) from a pretrained IQL-style critic and a continuous-time diffusion behavior model, without any diffusion sampling at evaluation. The policy is trained with a reverse-KL behavior-regularized objective max E[Q(s,a)] - (1/beta) KL(pi||mu); the KL gradient is replaced by the behavior score function ∇_a log mu(a|s) estimated by the diffusion model (averaged over diffusion times with weight omega(t)=sigma_t^2 and a baseline term for variance reduction), so the Q-gradient is directly regularized by the behavior score.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: offline RL, behavior-regularized policy optimization with diffusion behavior modeling ('SRPO tackles the behavior-regularized policy optimization problem and provides a computationally efficient way to realize behavior regularization through diffusion behavior modeling')
